title: Hit position (%)
description: Receptor position as percent of playfield height (55–95)

title: Lane cover (%)
description: Black cover from the top as percent of height (0–70)

title: Playfield size (%)
description: Notefield size as percent of the overlay (20–100)

title: Transparent background
description: Transparent page background for OBS browser sources

title: Roxysu watermark
description: Draw the Roxysu logo + wordmark on the notefield

title: Song-select preview
description: Show the playfield preview while in song select (no map)

title: Hide while playing
description: Hide the notefield during gameplay; still show in song select

title: Import .osk (URL or path)
description: tosu has no file picker here. Paste a URL or a path relative to this counter (put the .osk in the RoxysuPreview folder, e.g. ./myskin.osk) and save. You can also drop an .osk onto the preview.

title: Reset imported skin
description: Turn on and save to remove the imported .osk, then turn it off again
